description:
Confirmed / projected starting lineups for every game on a given league + date, split into home and away rosters. Available on every KingsPlaybook plan, including Free.

Args: league ('nba' | 'mlb' | 'nhl'), date ('YYYY-MM-DD').
Returns JSON: { data: [ { event_id, league, game_date, home_team, away_team, lineups: { home: [players], away: [players] }, updated_at } ], meta: { count, league, date, as_of } }.
name: kingsplaybook_get_lineups
title: Get confirmed lineups
